parts.html: The K-18 model is a modern gray L-shaped kitchen with solid-color laminated chipboard fronts.
Neutral gray works with light walls, wood, stone, decorative plaster, and modern flooring. The fronts are solid, without a pattern, and do not compete with the finishes.

The layout is L-shaped and 4.8 linear meters long. Cabinets, work surfaces, and built-in appliances run along two adjoining walls, and the rest of the floor area stays free, for example for a dining area.
A cargo pull-out provides storage. Muller soft-close hinges close the doors gently, and the drawers glide out on concealed Muller runners.
The K-18 cabinets are designed for built-in appliances. Handles are included; the basic model has no lift-up mechanisms.
Cabinet sizes, the number of storage systems, and the shade of the fronts can all be changed on the K-18: we make the kitchen to fit your room.
